coverage_notes: All registered anchors on PDF pp.2-4 and composition/method text on p.2 were visually inspected; p.1 title/abstract also viewed. Poppler font warnings did not obstruct the readable source pages.
shared_qualifications: C6: mV/hr / 3600 = mV/s: 200 -> 0.0555556 and 2000 -> 0.555556. All source potentials are vs saturated calomel, so V x 1000 gives mV without a reference offset.

CRA 458-460 Comments incorrectly say Table VI (which is corrosion-rate data); the corresponding potentials are Table IV for Ti-stabilized heat 4073A. Source Table I lists Cr 18.15, Mo 1.97, Ni 0.11, Mn 0.34 wt.%, and Table IV Ti 0.47 wt.%; CRA lists Cr 16.45, Mn 0.034 and Ti 0.0. Identity is supported by the distinctive Mo heat and the matched 815/925/1035 C treatment/result series; composition conflicts remain explicit.

Shared CRA 458 and 460 summarize several individual Table IV determinations, not source-reported averages. CRA Avg values 300 and 540 are compatible central summaries, while Min 270 and 500 are the source minima. Individual replicates are not required to equal the central target; no new observation or source mean is manufactured.

CRA 461-467 are ranges/summaries of the registered Mo-free 4354A graphical determinations. Every shared link is an individual member of that condition group; graphical resolution, rather than CSV decimal precision, governs agreement. CRA 465 collapses approximately 325-335 mV to 330/330.

Method p.2 reports microscopy after each run and accepts distinct pits away from masked edges despite possible simultaneous crevice corrosion; this qualification does not automatically exclude source outcomes.
